Define Concept with Parent.description: Define a concept that specialises (is subsumed by) a parent concept

Define Property.description: Define a typed data property on a concept

Define Optional Property.description: Define a data property with an explicit cardinality

Define Relation.description: Define a binary relational association between concepts

Define Individual.description: Declare a named individual of a concept

Universal Bound Axiom.description: Every instance of a concept satisfies a bound on a property

Universal Range Axiom.description: Every instance of a concept keeps a property within [min, max]

Existential Axiom.description: Assert that some instance of a concept exists with a property condition

Import File.description: Import an external ontology definition file
